title: Itni ghareeb hogayi gham yoon lipatt gaye
body:
Itni ghareeb hogayi gham yoon lipatt gaye
Zainab kay ek libaas mein doh saal katt gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Kya Kya guzar gayi hai Moharram kay chaand mai
Saidaaniyo kay baqth achaanak ulatt gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab ka dil bhi kya tha ghamoun ki kitaab thi
Ek dil mein us ghareeb kay sau gham simatt gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Haathoun sey maa kay khaimey ka pardaa ulatt gaya
Haathoun pey shah kay jis ghadi Asghar ulatt gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Bolay Hussain beti sey paani na maangna
Jin baazuoun pey mashk thi woh baazu katt gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Marney chaley Hussain toh rehwaar rukk gaya
Doh nanhey nanhey haath sumao sey lipatt gaye
<<DIVIDER>>
Kaisey uttha sakeingay bhalaa laash ko Hussain
Aaza Hassan kay laal kay tukkdoun mein batt gaye
